text:
maya (PM): Quick sync — kicking off the graceful-degrade orchestration initiative next sprint. Need alignment on sequencing + clear launch gates across product/eng/runtime/infra/security. Who's available for a 20m tomorrow?

sam (Eng): I can do 20m. high level Q: do we expect runtime to switch model variants on user-level or route to a different serving tier?

jordan (Runtime): Prefer routing to a compatible variant + light-weight local fallback to cached responses. Per-tenant switching is higher risk. We can ship a 1st-pass fallback (route by model-family) in ~1 week, but full variant mapping & weights needs ~2 weeks.

leila (Infra): For routing fallback we need a reserved prewarm pool and an autoscale policy to avoid cold-start spikes. Can we define expected burst QPS and per-tenant caps?

maya (PM): Good — goals: 1) keep 95th latency < target when primary model unavailable, 2) preserve output fidelity within defined delta, 3) enable canary + quick rollback. Burst estimate: 2x baseline traffic for first 24h of rollouts, per-tenant cap 100 req/s for pilot customers.

ethan (Security): Need to confirm data-compliance surface: fallbacks may use smaller-quantized models — are they allowed for regulated customers? Also require audit events for any fallback decision (who, why, model-id). KMS for any persisted cache keys.

alex (SRE): We'll want an SLO runway and alerting for elevated fallback rates. Suggest adding a metric fallback_rate{tenant, route, model_variant} and an automated paged alert if fallback_rate > 5% for 5m.

sam (Eng): Implementation note: runtime can emit fallback decision events now, but adding model-id and reason will need a small schema change in event proto. Will land a backward-compatible change — ETA 3 days.

jordan (Runtime): Confirming: minimal path plan — (A) fast path: route to exact model variant if available, (B) fallback path: route to family-compatible quantized variant in same region, (C) degrade path: serve cached prefix where applicable. We can do A+B in 1wk for alpha. C requires cache index and TTL tuning from infra.

leila (Infra): For prewarm pools and cache: propose config snippet for autoscale and pool reservation. Can we validate?

leila (Infra): ```
prewarm_pool:
  type: reserved
  gpu_count: 4
  reserved_for: graceful-degrade-pilot
  autoscale:
    min: 2
    max: 12
    scale_metric: requests_per_sec
    threshold: 200
```

maya (PM): That looks good as a starting config. Acceptance criteria for launch I propose:
- Canary with 5% traffic for 48h with fallback_rate < 2%
- Regression tests for quality (prompt set) pass with avg BLEU/ROUGE delta < 3%
- Security signoff on allowed model variants and audit event coverage
- Infra provides prewarm pool and documented rollback knobs

ethan (Security): Will triage allowed-variant list. For regulated tenants we'll require explicit opt-in to fallbacks — default is no fallback to quantized models. Need policy doc by EOD Friday.

alex (SRE): I'll add the fallback_rate metric + dashboard. Also will create runbook: how to disable routing fallback globally and per-tenant.

sam (Eng): For rollout steps: feature-flag guarded; runtime proto change; infra pool; canary policy; QA perf runs. Rough timeline: proto change + unit tests (3d), runtime rollout alpha (4d), infra config (2d), end-to-end canary (2d).

maya (PM): Thanks — sounds like we have a rough plan. Action items:
- sam: open RFC for proto change + PR link (due in 24h)
- jordan: deliver alpha routing code + integration tests (1w)
- leila: create infra pool + autoscale template in staging (3d)
- ethan: policy doc for regulated tenants (EOD Fri)
- alex: dashboard + runbook (3d)
- maya: draft acceptance criteria + canary checklist, schedule 20m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder: "graceful-degrade sync" tomorrow 10:30am PT in #product — RSVP +1

maya (PM): One more thing — let's predefine rollback thresholds: fallback_rate > 5% for 15m OR latency p95 > target + 150ms for 15m triggers automatic rollback. OK?

jordan (Runtime): OK to those thresholds. We'll implement an API that infra/sre can call to flip fallback off.

sam (Eng): I'll include tests that simulate region-wide model loss and verify rollback triggers.

leila (Infra): Noted — will wire the API to the autoscale controller and provide kill-switch in console.

ethan (Security): For audit events: include tenant_id, decision_reason, model_id, and triggering_metric. Will share event schema by EOD.

maya (PM): Great. I'll capture all items in the initiative doc and tag owners. If nobody objects, we'll treat this thread as the handoff record for the sprint kickoff. Thanks all :rocket:
